# Step 2: Fetch all songs in Spotify song library (paginated)
import math

song_dict = {}  # song_id -> {'title':..., 'artists':...}
access_token_spotify = spotify_login['access_token']

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
pages_fetched = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token_spotify, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    pages_fetched += 1
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        sid = s['song_id']
        title = s.get('title','')
        artists = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists',[])])
        if sid not in song_dict:
            song_dict[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}
    # If fewer than page_limit results returned, might still have more; rely on empty next page per spec.
    page_index += 1

print('song_library pages_fetched:', pages_fetched)
print('unique songs from song_library:', len(song_dict))
# show a few samples
items = list(song_dict.items())[:5]
print('sample:', [(k, v['title'], v['artists']) for k,v in items])

# Step 3: Fetch all playlists and add their songs (unique by song_id)
access_token_spotify = spotify_login['access_token']

playlist_ids = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
playlist_pages = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token_spotify, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    playlist_pages += 1
    if not page:
        break
    for p in page:
        playlist_ids.append(p['playlist_id'])
    page_index += 1

print('playlist_library pages_fetched:', playlist_pages)
print('total playlists in library:', len(playlist_ids))

added_from_playlists = 0
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token_spotify)
    for song in pl.get('songs', []):
        sid = song.get('id')
        if sid is None:
            continue
        if sid not in song_dict:
            title = song.get('title','')
            artists = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in song.get('artists', [])])
            song_dict[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}
            added_from_playlists += 1

print('unique songs after adding playlists:', len(song_dict))
print('songs added from playlists:', added_from_playlists)
# verify a couple
print('sample last:', list(song_dict.items())[-3:])

# Build CSV content from the previously fetched song_dict (unique by song_id)

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Sort deterministically by Title then Artists
rows = []
for sid, rec in song_dict.items():
    title = rec.get('title','')
    artists = rec.get('artists','')  # already '|' separated
    rows.append((title, artists, sid))

rows_sorted = sorted(rows, key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower(), x[2]))

header = 'Title,Artists'
lines = [header]
for title, artists, sid in rows_sorted:
    lines.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists)}")

csv_text = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

print('rows count:', len(rows_sorted))
print('csv size bytes:', len(csv_text.encode('utf-8')))
print('header:', header)
print('first 5 lines:')
print('\n'.join(lines[:6]))
print('last 3 lines:')
print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]))
